# Product Brief: Pantry Pal

## Executive Summary
Pantry Pal helps busy households know what food they have before it expires.

## Problem Statement
Families throw away food because they forget what is in the pantry.

## Target Users
- Primary: parents who do the weekly shop
- Secondary: roommates sharing a kitchen

## Success Metrics
- 40% of users log at least 10 items in week one
